BUILT FOR THE EVERYDAY BUSINESS OWNER

You built the business.
Let’s build the connections.

The shop on your street. The café around the corner. The online store that started with an idea. Small businesses put real work into winning customers and building trust.

Staying in touch shouldn’t require an enterprise marketing team. Hello Customer aims to make professional customer communication simpler with useful tools in one accessible, mobile-focused platform.

Practical technology. Meaningful relationships.

Developed under SaralKaro, Hello Customer is part of a belief that technology should make business simpler. We’re building for the people who know their customers by name.

Made for businesses.

Useful tools for the real work of running a small or growing business.

Simple to use.

Guided experiences that make staying in touch more approachable.

Built for growth.

Better communication and stronger relationships, one connection at a time.
